$schema: How to make each ASL letter, in plain English. Shown on Letter detail (S7) and as the hint on Play (S4). Same text on both platforms.

A.how: Make a fist with your thumb resting against the side of your index finger.

B.how: Hold four fingers straight up together and fold your thumb across your palm.

C.how: Curve your fingers and thumb as if holding a small cup, leaving a gap.

D.how: Point your index finger up. Touch the tips of your other fingers to your thumb.

E.how: Curl your fingertips down to rest on your thumb, tucked across your palm.

F.how: Touch your index fingertip to your thumb. Keep the other three fingers up and apart.

G.how: Point your index finger and thumb sideways, parallel, with the other fingers folded.

H.how: Hold your index and middle fingers together, pointing sideways.

I.how: Make a fist and raise your little finger straight up.

J.how: Make an I and draw a J in the air with your little finger.

K.how: Raise your index and middle fingers in a V and put your thumb between them.

L.short: Thumb and index make an L
L.how: Point your index finger up and your thumb out to the side.

M.how: Fold three fingers over your thumb, which sits under them.

N.how: Fold two fingers over your thumb, which sits under them.

O.how: Curve all your fingers to meet your thumb in a round O.

P.how: Make a K, then tilt your hand so your fingers point down.

Q.how: Make a G, then tilt your hand so your index and thumb point down.

R.how: Cross your middle finger over your index finger, both pointing up.

S.how: Make a fist with your thumb wrapped across the front of your fingers.

T.how: Make a fist with your thumb tucked between your index and middle fingers.

U.how: Hold your index and middle fingers straight up, touching.

V.how: Hold your index and middle fingers up in a V.

W.how: Hold your index, middle and ring fingers up and apart. Thumb holds the little finger.

X.how: Make a fist and raise your index finger, bent into a hook.

Y.how: Make a fist, then stretch your thumb and little finger out.

Z.how: Point your index finger and draw a Z in the air.
